body:
If I run "npm test" from a clean checkout on a Mac OSX 10.10.4 I get the following error:

 1) CLIEngine executeOnFiles() Fix Mode should return fixed text on multiple files when in fix mode:

```
  AssertionError: expected { Object (results, errorCount, ...) } to deeply equal { Object (results, errorCount, ...) }
  + expected - actual

     "errorCount": 1
     "results": [
       {
         "errorCount": 0
  -      "filePath": "/private/var/folders/_q/001g73y56vl24brvfcv0tl6m0000gn/T/eslint/fixtures/fixmode/ok.js"
  +      "filePath": "/var/folders/_q/001g73y56vl24brvfcv0tl6m0000gn/T/eslint/fixtures/fixmode/ok.js"
         "messages": []
         "warningCount": 0
       }
       {
         "errorCount": 0
  -      "filePath": "/private/var/folders/_q/001g73y56vl24brvfcv0tl6m0000gn/T/eslint/fixtures/fixmode/quotes-semi-eqeqeq.js"
  +      "filePath": "/var/folders/_q/001g73y56vl24brvfcv0tl6m0000gn/T/eslint/fixtures/fixmode/quotes-semi-eqeqeq.js"
         "messages": []
         "output": "var msg = \"hi\";\nif (msg === \"hi\") {\n\n}\n"
         "warningCount": 0
       }
       {
         "errorCount": 1
  -      "filePath": "/private/var/folders/_q/001g73y56vl24brvfcv0tl6m0000gn/T/eslint/fixtures/fixmode/quotes.js"
  +      "filePath": "/var/folders/_q/001g73y56vl24brvfcv0tl6m0000gn/T/eslint/fixtures/fixmode/quotes.js"
         "messages": [
           {
             "column": 18
             "line": 1

  at Function.assert.deepEqual (node_modules/chai/lib/chai/interface/assert.js:205:32)
  at Context.<anonymous> (tests/lib/cli-engine.js:700:24)
```
